about_the_game:
After watching 1000+ anime they decided to make a game portraying the current situation of mankind. Currently being developed by a solo dev Kurozzz who lacks knowledge and skills in art or game development.

This game is about daily life of a normal guy who wants to be happy in life. But who are truly happy in life? Very few people in this world. This is pretty much relatable to most guys out there trying to live a life. You might find some similarities with your own life too.

It has a single Japanese female character fully voiced in Japanese. So if you are an anime fan or skilled enough to understand Japanese voice lines then you will find it more interesting. If you dont understand Japanese then don't worry you will be able to read the subtitles in English like every Anime fan does.

Game will be around 2 hours long depending on your playstyle. I will keep the description short to avoid spoilers so feel free to Wishlist and Follow it while the development continues. It will be released very soon.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible card.
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.10+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (no special GPU needed)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10/11 or Any
  • Processor: PDC/ i3 (Yes Your Laptop Without Graphics Card Can Run It)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (No Graphics Card Required, Can Run From Your Processor)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: You Just Need A PC To Run This, Yes Even A Potato Can Run It!

short_description: When a guy who watched over 1000 Anime decides to make a game while lacking skills or help from friends. He decides to make a visual novel game with the main theme being - something that a Man needs in order to be happy. The story will vary with your prospective of life and happiness.
